component.name: enzim Browser
component.summary: Browse with flexible tabs and per-site privacy controls

description.p: Browse with horizontal or vertical tabs, separate your work in profiles and containers, and control what individual sites can access. Capture or export whole pages and manage your downloads.
This is an alpha release for testing and feedback.
Render pages at the window scale, adapt Reader pages to narrow windows, and preserve launch URLs through setup.
First enzim Apps release. Arrange tabs across the top or in a sidebar, keep browsing separate with profiles and private windows, and manage content blocking and permissions by site.
